name: Agent LLM Call
description: Sends a prompt to an LLM and writes the response back as a process variable. Place inside an Agent Task (ad hoc sub-process).

properties.label: Prompt
properties.description: The prompt sent to the LLM. Embed process variables with ${variableName}, e.g. Summarize: ${inputText}

properties.label: System Prompt
properties.description: Optional system prompt for the LLM call. Embed process variables with ${variableName}

properties.label: Output Variable Name
properties.description: Process variable that will hold the LLM's response text

properties.label: Max Iterations
properties.description: Caps the tool-calling loop: how many times this agent may call a tool before it must answer with whatever it has.

properties.label: Memory Window Size
properties.description: Number of past conversation turns to remember across runs of this Agent Task in the same process instance. 0 disables memory.
